units.source_text: 第二天，我们搬进了自己的家。

en.t: The next day, we moved into a house of our own.

units.source_text: 这里正门处有藤萝架，有杉树林和竹林，是一座模型般的庭院。

en.t: Near the front gate there was a wisteria trellis, with groves of cedar and bamboo, making it a garden like a miniature model.

units.source_text: 还有红鲤鱼游弋的泉水。

en.t: There was also spring water where red carp swam.

units.source_text: 天花板上贴有仿神代杉的木板——只看到这些，就决定住了进来。

en.t: The ceiling was lined with boards imitating ancient cedar; seeing only these things, we decided to move in.

units.source_text: 安顿停当后，在附近走了走。

en.t: After settling in, we walked around the neighborhood for a while.

units.source_text: 富有讽刺意味的是到处都有空房子。

en.t: Ironically, there were vacant houses everywhere.

units.source_text: 住了不到一星期，我们又决定搬迁到森林里葺着红色洋灰瓦的洋房里住。

en.t: Before we had lived there even a week, we decided to move again, this time into a Western-style house in the woods roofed with red cement tiles.

units.source_text: 我们对有藤萝架的房子的房东说，因为邻居的收音机铺太吵闹，其实是因为无法缴纳人家紧催着要的租房押金。

en.t: We told the landlord of the house with the wisteria trellis that the radio shop next door was too noisy, but in truth it was because we could not pay the rental deposit he was urgently pressing us for.
